recommendation: Use the two concrete priority checks as a small feasibility pilot, then apply the same claim-centred selection to additional unread submissions if useful. No high-yield pool has yet been demonstrated.

counting.pilot_reading_extent: Actual selection reads and excluded candidates are separately recorded in branch files; not silently added to the audited565-unit snapshot.

inference_limit: Targeted selection can identify cases to investigate; it cannot supply a representative error rate or predict the eventual yield.
